sources.entry: FastoRedis - Cross-platform professional GUI management tool for Redis. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/fastogt/fastoredis) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: FastoRedis is a cross-platform, open-source GUI administration tool for Redis databases, forked from FastoNoSQL.
summary.what_it_does: FastoRedis is described as a cross-platform open source Redis management tool, i.e. an admin GUI. The README names Windows, macOS X and Linux as platforms and says compiled versions are available for Mac OS X, Windows, FreeBSD and Linux from the project website. It is a fork of FastoNoSQL. The README contains no detailed feature list. The repository also includes a clang-format style file and a CMake target for style checks (cmake -DCHECK_STYLE=ON, make check_style) that needs clang-tidy. The project is licensed under GPL version 3.
use_cases: managing a Redis server through a graphical interface
administering Redis on macOS, Windows or Linux
replacing command-line redis-cli work with a GUI
how_to_run: Download a compiled version from www.fastoredis.com
Build instructions: see the 'Build FastoNoSQL' documentation linked in the README
notable: Cross-platform Redis admin GUI for macOS, Windows and Linux
Prebuilt binaries available from the project website
caveats: README gives little detail on features and build steps; it points to external docs and the project website
Build documentation is only linked, not included in the README
